beats.label: S1 · The mission
beats.text: In 2043, scientist Katarina Jones sends James Cole back to 2015 to find virologist Cassandra Railly and stop the plague that gutted humanity.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise, the two leads, and the time-travel mechanism the rest of the series runs on.

beats.label: S1 · The Army surfaces
beats.text: Chasing the plague's source leads Cole and Cassie to the Army of the 12 Monkeys, a cult served by the Pallid Man and steered by an unseen Witness.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the antagonist faction and its shadowy leader, the spine of every future season.

beats.label: S1 · Jennifer Goines
beats.text: In a psych ward Cole finds Jennifer Goines, unstable heiress to Markridge and one of few who knows the location of her father's Night Room lab.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jennifer, who becomes a load-bearing Primary and drives later seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Ramse turns
beats.text: Cole's oldest friend Jose Ramse, terrified erasing the plague will erase his son Sam, steals the splinter drug and jumps back to sabotage the mission.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ramse's defection sets up the season finale and his season-two hostility toward Cole.

beats.label: S1 · Ramse's long game
beats.text: Stranded in 1987, Ramse joins the Army under Olivia and spends decades using his memory of Cole's future moves to make sure the plague still happens.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the Army is always one step ahead and reveals Olivia as a long-term operator.

beats.label: S1 · Aaron's betrayal
beats.text: Cassie's partner Aaron Marker sells Cole out to the Army in exchange for her safety, and Cole survives only via a paradox that burns off his time-travel ability.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Cole's splinter capability heading into the finale and marks Aaron as a traitor.

beats.label: S1 · Machine changes hands
beats.text: In 2015 Ramse escapes to 2043 as Cassie is shot, so Cole sends her forward for Jones to save; in 2043, Deacon's raiders seize the time machine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The end state of season 1: Cassie stranded in 2043, Cole trapped in 2015, machine captured.

cliffhanger.text: Cassie, gutshot, has just splintered into 2043 as Deacon's twelve raiders storm the temporal facility and Jones surrenders the machine. Cole is left in 2015 without a way home, and in 1947-vintage secrecy the Army readies twelve mysterious newborns for something 28 years away.
questions: Can Jones save Cassie, and what will she be like on the far side of the trip?
Who is the Witness the Army keeps invoking, and what does the Army actually want?
How does Cole get off 2015 now that his ability to splinter is gone?

characters.name: James Cole
characters.line: Reluctant chrononaut from 2043 sent back to erase the plague; ends the season stranded in 2015 with no splinter ability.

characters.name: Cassandra 'Cassie' Railly
characters.line: Virologist who became Cole's partner in 2015 and is now bleeding out in 2043, having been shot escaping the Army.

characters.name: Katarina Jones
characters.line: Grief-hardened scientist who built Project Splinter and just handed the time machine to Deacon's raiders to save her people.

characters.name: Jose Ramse
characters.line: Cole's best friend turned enemy, who joined the Army in 1987 to preserve his son and has spent decades ensuring the plague still happens.

characters.name: Jennifer Goines
characters.line: Mentally fragile Markridge heiress now controlling her father's company; boards a plane at the finale seemingly to release the plague.

characters.name: Aaron Marker
characters.line: Cassie's ex-boyfriend and political aide who betrayed Cole to the Army and was apparently killed in a fire soon after.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: Composed, long-serving Army lieutenant grooming twelve infant 'Messengers' for a plan decades away.

characters.name: The Pallid Man
characters.line: The Army's scarred, softly menacing enforcer and Olivia's field arm against Cole and Cassie.

characters.name: Deacon
characters.line: West VII warlord who lost the facility in the pilot and, in the finale, leads twelve strangers who seize the time machine.

beats.label: S2 · The Messengers
beats.text: In 2043 the twelve who took the machine reveal themselves as the Messengers and scatter through history; Cassie helps Deacon blow them and the machine up.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains who Deacon's group actually was and how the machine ends up gone at the start.

beats.label: S2 · Cassie changes sides
beats.text: Cassie splinters back and stops Cole from killing Jennifer, then leaves him in 2016 with Ramse, returning to 2044 hardened and willing to execute her former enemies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Cassie's darker post-2043 self, the season's biggest character shift.

beats.label: S2 · Primaries and paradox
beats.text: Cole and Cassie learn the Army hunts Primaries — people psychically bound to time like Jennifer — and murders them ritually to trigger paradoxes that shred the timeline.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Primaries and the Army's actual endgame: destroying time itself.

beats.label: S2 · Jennifer's Hyenas
beats.text: In 2016 Jennifer builds the Hyenas, a squad of ex-patients hunting the Army; the Pallid Man lets himself be captured and bombs them all dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jennifer's grief and isolation carry into her role as Primary and mystic later.

beats.label: S2 · Olivia unmade
beats.text: In 1961 the team find Nazi scientist Kirschner engineered Olivia herself for the Army; the reveal, plus a later betrayal, makes Olivia abandon her masters.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Olivia's break from the Army sets up her later manipulations from a new position.

beats.label: S2 · Titan and the Red Forest
beats.text: Ramse and Cassie mutiny to find Titan, a place linked to the Witness; the storms consume the facility, killing Jones — or so it seems — and the machine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Titan becomes the central location of the next season and reshapes the whole geography.

beats.label: S2 · Cassie is the Mother
beats.text: Cole erases the year he and Cassie lived together in 1957 to stop the final paradox; Cassie is captured into Titan in 2163 and hailed as mother of the Witness.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with the reveal that reframes everything: the Witness is Cassie's child.

cliffhanger.text: Titan has splintered away to 2163 with a pregnant Cassie inside, where the Army greets her as the mother of the Witness. Cole is chasing after her; Jennifer is stranded in World War I; Ramse has vanished pursuing Olivia and Sam; the facility and Jones are gone.
questions: Who is the father of the Witness, and does Cole already know?
Can Cole reach Cassie in 2163 before the child is born, and would stopping the birth even be right?
With the facility and Jones destroyed, is there any way home for anyone scattered across time?

characters.name: James Cole
characters.line: In love with Cassie and unraveling, having just erased their year together in 1957 and chased her to 2163.

characters.name: Cassandra Railly
characters.line: Pregnant captive in Titan in 2163, being told by the Pallid Man that her unborn son is the Witness the Army worships.

characters.name: Katarina Jones
characters.line: Project Splinter's founder, believed lost when the temporal storms consumed the facility around her and the machine.

characters.name: Jose Ramse
characters.line: Splintered off after Olivia, who has taken his adult son Sam; no longer Cole's enemy but no longer with him either.

characters.name: Jennifer Goines
characters.line: Confirmed Primary and Daughters leader, hit by a stray beam and flung into the trenches of World War I.

characters.name: Deacon
characters.line: Reformed warlord who died at Titan saving Jennifer during the assault on the Witness's stronghold.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: Ex-Army leader who learned she was engineered by Nazi scientists and walked away, now operating on her own agenda.

characters.name: The Pallid Man
characters.line: Revealed as Olivia's brother and now Titan's chief priest, presenting Cassie to the assembled Army.

characters.name: The Witness
characters.line: Titan's masked prophet, whose face Cassie has seen as both Aaron and Cole in visions and who is now confirmed to be her son.

beats.label: S3 · The birth
beats.text: In 2163 Cassie tries to kill herself to prevent the birth; the Horseman Magdalena splinters back to preempt her, and Cassie's son is born and named Athan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Magdalena's timeline-editing ability and the fact that Athan actually exists.

beats.label: S3 · Cole rescued twice
beats.text: A future Cole steers his past self away from Titan toward Jennifer in 1922, where they and Jones kill three Horsemen before Magdalena resets the day.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the surviving team in 2046 with Jennifer, and gets Cassie out of Titan by finale.

beats.label: S3 · Ramse learns the truth
beats.text: Olivia surrenders to Project Splinter and privately tells Ramse the Witness is Cole and Cassie's son, then engineers his 2007 mission to kill Cassie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Olivia's manipulation from captivity drives Ramse's fatal confrontation with Cole.

beats.label: S3 · Ramse's death
beats.text: In 2007 Cole realises Ramse's real target is Cassie, and mortally wounds his oldest friend, who dies begging Cole not to undo it with time travel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Ramse and closes their whole arc; his last request will be tested in season 4.

beats.label: S3 · Meeting their son
beats.text: In 1953 Cole and Cassie find young Athan being groomed as a Primary killer for the Army; unable to shoot him, they steal a personal machine and flee with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Cole and Cassie into fugitives from Jones and reframes Athan as a person, not a target.

beats.label: S3 · Athan's grief
beats.text: Athan's journals show a lifetime jumping through time, then losing the woman he loved in 1891; he decides destroying time is the only way to reach her again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Provides Athan's motive for the Red Forest plan and humanises the Witness completely.

beats.label: S3 · Olivia is the Witness
beats.text: In 1959 Athan tells Olivia she was always the true Witness; she kills him and orders Titan splintered to 2046 to level the temporal facility.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the real antagonist and launches the direct assault that opens season 4.

cliffhanger.text: Athan is dead by his mother's hand, and Olivia — revealed as the true Witness the Army was worshipping all along — is bringing Titan into 2046 to destroy Project Splinter. In 2015, young Cole is handed a cryptic note from a mother he was told he never knew.
questions: How does Jones's tiny facility survive Titan splintering in on top of it?
If Olivia is the Witness, what has the Army actually been building toward, and can it still be stopped?
Who is Cole's mother, and why is she reaching out to him now through the past?

characters.name: James Cole
characters.line: Reunited with Cassie in 2046, hardened by killing Ramse and by failing to save the son he barely knew.

characters.name: Cassandra Railly
characters.line: Escaped Titan and back with Cole, but split from Jones after refusing to let anyone kill Athan.

characters.name: Katarina Jones
characters.line: Running Project Splinter from 2046, willing to hunt Cole and Cassie down when she learns they're protecting the Witness.

characters.name: Jennifer Goines
characters.line: Rescued from 1922, back at the facility, and beginning to hear the Primaries again through her visions.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: Confirmed as the true Witness, who let herself be captured to manipulate Ramse and now commands Titan directly.

characters.name: Athan Cole
characters.line: Cole and Cassie's Primary son, raised by the Army as a killer and shot by his own mother in 1959.

characters.name: Jose Ramse
characters.line: Dead in 2007, killed by Cole after Olivia tricked him into hunting Cassie; made Cole promise not to reverse it.

characters.name: Deacon
characters.line: Loyal to Jones and now her enforcer, tasked with hunting Cole and Cassie across time.

characters.name: Mallick
characters.line: Titan enforcer who helped Cassie and Deacon escape and now serves Olivia's inner circle.

beats.label: S4 · Titan attacks
beats.text: Titan splinters onto the facility; Whitley and Lasky die, Deacon is left behind, and Jones splinters the whole facility away, absorbing a lethal radiation dose.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the war Titan opened with, at the cost of Jones's life expectancy and a key soldier.

beats.label: S4 · The Primaries' weapon
beats.text: A medieval opening and a stolen ouroboros artifact point Cole to the Blackleaf clue: the Primaries built a weapon against the Witness, hidden across centuries.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the season-long treasure hunt that will end at Die Glocke in 1491.

beats.label: S4 · Cole's mother
beats.text: Cole's childhood story about the weapon came from his own mother, tying his family to the Primaries; Hannah is sent to 2009 to protect a woman named Marion Woods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the mother mystery that pays off with the Hannah reveal.

beats.label: S4 · Deacon returns
beats.text: Deacon survives Titan's rubble and appears to defect to Olivia, but he is secretly still Jones's man, feeding Project Splinter access as her captured double agent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Deacon's dual role through the middle stretch and his eventual death.

beats.label: S4 · The weapon burns
beats.text: In 1491 the ouroboros trail leads to Die Glocke, but Olivia kills Deacon and paradoxes the weapon out of reach forever, forcing a different plan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the weapon arc and forces the final-episode strategy of erasing Cole himself.

beats.label: S4 · Hannah is Cole's mother
beats.text: In 2018 Cole and Cassie release the plague to preserve causality; Hannah dies saving Cole and leaves a letter revealing she raised him as Marion Woods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's deepest paradox: the mission's success requires the plague and costs Cole his mother.

beats.label: S4 · Erasing Cole
beats.text: In a final battle at Titan, Cassie kills Olivia and Cole loads the Primaries' program to erase himself; a rewritten timeline lets him find Cassie at their farmhouse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Series conclusion: the causal loop is closed and both leads land in the same life.

cliffhanger.text: The series ends with Cole erased and reinserted into a new timeline where the plague, Project Splinter and the 12 Monkeys never existed. Cassie remembers everything and finds Cole waiting at the farmhouse they once shared in 1957.
questions: Does Cole remember Cassie, or only the life the new timeline gave him?
In a world without the plague, who did the people they lost — Jennifer, Ramse, Jones — grow up to be?
Is the loop truly closed, or does time still owe something to the Primaries whose program rewrote it?

characters.name: James Cole
characters.line: Ends the series erased and then quietly restored, walking back into Cassie's life in the new timeline.

characters.name: Cassandra Railly
characters.line: The only person who remembers what happened; finds Cole at their farmhouse after killing Olivia and stopping the Red Forest.

characters.name: Katarina Jones
characters.line: Dies at Titan after seeing the mission through, sharing a last conversation with Cole before he activates the program.

characters.name: Jennifer Goines
characters.line: Steered the whole team via her Primary visions, and is sent home to her own time after the paradox is averted.

characters.name: Jose Ramse
characters.line: Pulled forward from the moment before his death to help Cole assault Titan, then returned to his own time.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.line: The Witness, killed by Cassie in the final battle and splintered into the past to become the original plague-corpse.

characters.name: Deacon
characters.line: Jones's secret double agent inside the Army, killed by Olivia in 1491 during the fight for the weapon.

characters.name: Hannah Jones
characters.line: Katarina's daughter and, in secret, Cole's mother 'Marion Woods'; dies in 2018 shielding him from an Army assassin.

characters.name: Emma / Elliot Jones
characters.line: Katarina's ex-husband Elliot and his assistant Emma — Olivia's mother — are killed after their designs help finish Titan.
